coverageContext: European-discovery research model evaluated for incident pulmonary fibrosis alongside ambient sulfur dioxide exposure. GA reports the genetic sum only; study-group hazard ratios and exposure effects are not individual risks, and this is not a diagnostic or treatment test.

Research model developed predominantly in male European-ancestry samples, with European and African evaluation groups. It does not detect an existing aneurysm, predict rupture, or establish an imaging or surgery recommendation; clinical covariates are not reproduced.

Vitiligo-associated research model evaluated for anti-PD-L1-induced hypothyroidism in cancer patients, not for diagnosis of vitiligo. European evaluation does not establish general-population predictive utility. GA cannot predict immunotherapy response or guide treatment.

Research score evaluated for peripheral artery disease among UK Biobank participants with type 2 diabetes. GA does not reproduce the combined clinical/lifestyle model, diagnose impaired circulation or estimate absolute risk. Applicability outside this evaluation setting is unestablished.

Research model evaluated in a Chinese IgA nephropathy cohort. EUR comparisons are withheld because reported evaluation is East Asian. GA does not diagnose nephropathy, reproduce a clinical workup, or predict individual kidney failure or treatment benefit.
